phi.interval_scope: Individual reference intervals, not simultaneous across models/endpoints; bootstrap intervals are descriptive and zero width is not a zero-risk guarantee.
phi.sampling_assumption: Intervals use an independent-world sampling approximation for this artificial task generator. Balanced margins and unique field assignments couple the generated worlds, so these are model-based reference intervals, not unconditional guarantees. Fixed-sample counts are exact descriptive results. Neither repeated questions nor the two models create additional independent worlds.
phi.scope: All 64 confirmation worlds; both models share them, not 128 independent worlds.
